architectural_fidelity.reason: Same loft room with sloped ceiling, white walls with gray accent, dormer window in correct position, white door on right, same viewpoint from staircase landing, stair railing visible in foreground

furniture_removal.reason: Original sofa, TV stand, music stand, and cluttered items have been removed, but the original carpet flooring is partially retained rather than fully replaced—shows inconsistent flooring treatment between carpet remnants and new wood floor

style_commitment.reason: Clear bohemian execution with hanging rattan chair, mixed natural textiles in gray/cream/blue tones, wood flooring, plants, vintage-style pendant light, layered rugs, and eclectic seating—unmistakably bohemian

editorial_density.reason: Multiple layered textiles (bed linens, throw blanket, rugs, stair railing textile), hanging rattan chair, upholstered armchair, plants, wall clock, window styling, woven baskets, pendant lighting—achieves editorial 'lived-in' detail

photorealism.reason: Natural lighting and shadows are coherent, materials mostly realistic, but bed linens have slight CGI softness and the flooring transition between carpet and wood appears digitally uncertain—not fully convincing but acceptable

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers the requested bohemian style with personality and editorial layering while Collov offers only generic contemporary staging with no style specificity.
